sentences.zh: 这些疾病席卷了整个保留地。

sentences.en: Some people may remember that when we did the Battle of the Little Bighorn, there was a character called Black Elk.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能还记得，当我们讲到小大角战役时，有个叫黑麋鹿的角色。

sentences.en: Remember Black Elk, Tom?
sentences.zh: 还记得黑麋鹿吗，汤姆？

sentences.en: Yes, the little boy.
sentences.zh: 记得，那个小男孩。

sentences.en: He was a teenager, yeah, who scalped a trooper.
sentences.zh: 是的，他当时是个十几岁的少年，剥了一个骑兵的头皮。

sentences.en: Dreadful scene.
sentences.zh: 可怕的场景。

sentences.en: Hunted him like a rabbit in a bush.
sentences.zh: 像追赶灌木丛里的兔子一样追捕他。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He later gave, there's a book called Black Elk Speaks, one of the great kind of classics of writing about Native Americans.
sentences.zh: 他后来口述了一本书叫《黑麋鹿如是说》，是关于美洲原住民文学的经典之作。

sentences.en: Black Elk says of that winter, the people seemed heavy to me, heavy and dark.
sentences.zh: 黑麋鹿谈到那个冬天时说，人们在我看来显得沉重，沉重而阴郁。

sentences.en: So heavy it seemed they couldn't be lifted.
sentences.zh: 沉重得仿佛再也无法被抬起。

sentences.en: So dark they couldn't be made to see anymore.
sentences.zh: 阴郁得仿佛再也看不见光明。

sentences.en: Hunger was among us now.
sentences.zh: 饥饿现在笼罩着我们。

sentences.en: There were many lies, but we could not eat them.
sentences.zh: 谎言有很多，但我们无法以谎言充饥。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a terrible sentence, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这句话太沉重了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And it's in that context that the Lakota hear a rumor that far away beyond the Rocky Mountains,
sentences.zh: 正是在这种背景下，拉科塔人听到一个传言，说在遥远的落基山脉之外，

sentences.en: a messiah has come who will liberate them.
sentences.zh: 一位救世主降临了，他将解放他们。

sentences.en: They send a little party in the two most prominent people, a guy called Kicking Bear, who is a cousin of Crazy Horse, and a medicine man from the Brûlée called Short Bull.
sentences.zh: 他们派出了一个小代表团，由两位最重要的人物带队：一个是疯马的堂兄弟，名叫踢熊；另一个是来自布鲁尔部落的巫医，名叫短牛。

sentences.en: Off these guys go.
sentences.zh: 这些人出发了。

sentences.en: Obviously, it's a long way away, so they've gone for ages.
sentences.zh: 显然，路途遥远，所以他们去了很久。

sentences.en: And they come back in March 1890, and they say, unbelievable news.
sentences.zh: 他们在1890年3月回来，带回了令人难以置信的消息。

sentences.en: The Messiah is there.
sentences.zh: 救世主就在那里。

sentences.en: The son of the Holy Spirit, of the great spirits, rather.
sentences.zh: 圣灵之子，或者说是伟大神灵之子。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, that's a kind of telling slip, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，这算是个意味深长的口误，对吧？

sentences.en: Because, I mean, this is what's so fascinating, is that it's a conflation of traditional beliefs with Christianity.
sentences.zh: 因为，我是说，最迷人的地方就在于，这是传统信仰与基督教的融合。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he has come to basically liberate us.
sentences.zh: 他说他来这里基本上是为了解放我们。

sentences.en: So wonderful news, liberation is at hand.
sentences.zh: 真是天大的好消息，解放指日可待。

sentences.en: And it's going to happen, actually, next spring, spring of 1891.
sentences.zh: 而且这实际上就要发生了，就在明年春天，1891年的春天。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And this bloke, this messiah, his name was Wovoka, or his white friends knew him as Jack
sentences.zh: 这个家伙，这位救世主，他的名字叫沃沃卡，或者他的白人朋友叫他杰克·

sentences.en: Wilson, which is a little bit less inspirational, I suppose, than Wovoka.
sentences.zh: 威尔逊，我想这个名字比起沃沃卡来，少了一点灵感。

sentences.en: And he is a Paiute in his 30s.
sentences.zh: 他是一位30多岁的派尤特人。

sentences.en: And he was a medicine man with the Paiute.
sentences.zh: 他是派尤特部落的巫医。

sentences.en: But he was very westernized, as it were, sort of Christianized, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 但他非常西化，我想可以说是基督教化了。

sentences.en: He dressed like the white man's clothing.
sentences.zh: 他穿着白人的衣服。

sentences.en: He worked for a rancher.
sentences.zh: 他为牧场主工作。

sentences.en: He spoke English.
sentences.zh: 他会说英语。

sentences.en: And he had clearly learned about Christianity from this rancher out there in Nevada.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他是从内华达州的那位牧场主那里学到了基督教知识。

sentences.en: And the story goes that it was during a solar eclipse in 1889 that he had fallen very badly ill.
sentences.zh: 故事是这样的，1889年日食期间，他病得很重。

sentences.en: And he had had a vision.
sentences.zh: 他产生了一个幻象。

sentences.en: And he had ascended into heaven.
sentences.zh: 他升入了天堂。

sentences.en: And God had given him the good news and said, Jesus is on his way.
sentences.zh: 上帝给了他好消息，说耶稣正在赶来的路上。

sentences.en: Fantastic scenes.
sentences.zh: 梦幻般的场景。

sentences.en: And he's actually coming to help the native people.
sentences.zh: 他确实要来帮助原住民了。

sentences.en: But it's unclear, isn't it, whether he is actually Jesus?
sentences.zh: 但还不清楚，他到底是不是耶稣本人，对吧？

sentences.en: Because doesn't he have stigmata?
sentences.zh: 因为他身上不是有圣痕吗？

sentences.en: Yes, he does.
sentences.zh: 是的，他有。

sentences.en: The kind of the wounds of the nails in his hands and feet.
sentences.zh: 就是那种手脚上钉痕一样的伤口。

sentences.en: He does indeed.
sentences.zh: 他确实有。

sentences.en: And the trouble is, the accounts we have of him are very garbled and slightly contradictory.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，我们关于他的记载非常混乱，而且略有矛盾。

sentences.en: And what is clear as well is that the Lakota emissaries who returned, so Kicking Bear and
sentences.zh: 同样清楚的是，返回的拉科塔使者，也就是踢熊和

sentences.en: Short Bull, distorted his message in some way.
sentences.zh: 短牛，在某种程度上曲解了他的信息。

sentences.en: So it's very unclear.
sentences.zh: 所以情况很不明确。

sentences.en: But what is clear is that he says, good times are ahead for the Plains Indians.
sentences.zh: 但可以肯定的是，他说平原印第安人的好日子要来了。

sentences.en: But what you absolutely must do, he said, is you must be peaceful.
sentences.zh: 但他强调，你们绝对必须做到的，就是保持和平。

sentences.en: You must remain at peace.
sentences.zh: 你们必须保持和平。

sentences.en: You mustn't take up arMs.
sentences.zh: 你们绝不能拿起武器。

sentences.en: You must show love.
sentences.zh: 你们必须展现爱。

sentences.en: And above all, you must dance.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，你们必须跳舞。

sentences.en: The dance is really important.
sentences.zh: 舞蹈非常重要。

sentences.en: So the dance will be a big thing where you dance around a pole, a little bit like a sun dance.
sentences.zh: 所以舞蹈会是一件大事，大家围着一根柱子跳，有点像太阳舞。

sentences.en: The more you dance, as you dance, you break down the barriers between this world and the next.
sentences.zh: 跳得越多，在跳舞的过程中，你就打破了这个世界和下一个世界之间的隔阂。

sentences.en: So you'll be able to see and feel, I guess, your dead family and friends.
sentences.zh: 这样你就能看到并感受到你死去的家人和朋友了。

sentences.en: Hence the name, the ghost dance.
sentences.zh: 所以才叫“鬼舞”。

sentences.en: You dress in these white robes or shirts, which are decorated with moons and stars and things.
sentences.zh: 你们穿着这些白色的长袍或衬衫，上面装饰着月亮、星星之类的图案。

sentences.en: And they're kind of proof against bullets, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 而且它们能防弹，对吧？

sentences.en: They're proof against bullets.
sentences.zh: 它们能防弹。

sentences.en: Although it's not clear whether that's a detail that was added later, whether he said they were proof against bullets.
sentences.zh: 虽然不清楚这是否是后来添加的细节，也不清楚是否是他亲口说能防弹的。

sentences.en: And it's communal.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一种集体活动。

sentences.en: So it's a different kind of dance from the sun dance.
sentences.zh: 所以它和太阳舞那种舞蹈不同。

sentences.en: Because in the sun dance...
sentences.zh: 因为在太阳舞中……

sentences.en: Yeah, it's competitive, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，那是竞争性的，对吧？

sentences.en: Obviously, the sun dance is kind of, there's loads of people there.
sentences.zh: 显然，太阳舞现场人很多。

sentences.en: But in the sun dance, you personally commune with the spirits.
sentences.zh: 但在太阳舞中，你是个人与神灵交流。

sentences.en: And it's very much a private experience for you.
sentences.zh: 这非常像是一种私人体验。

sentences.en: But also, if you fail at it, then you fail as an individual.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你没能完成，那你作为个人就失败了。

sentences.en: Yeah, you do.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Whereas in the ghost dance, you're all holding hands, which the Sioux didn't used to do when they danced.
sentences.zh: 而在鬼舞中，大家手拉手，这在苏族人以前跳舞时是不做的。

sentences.en: So it's very much everybody together.
sentences.zh: 所以这非常强调大家在一起。

sentences.en: And as soon as you've had a vision, you must share it with your friends and swap the good news and all this kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 一旦你有了幻象，就必须与朋友分享，交换好消息之类的。

sentences.en: So very kind of Quaker-ish.
sentences.zh: 所以有点像贵格会教徒。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Assembly, the spirit coming on you, talking, having visions, Pentecostalist, speaking in tongues.
sentences.zh: 聚会、圣灵降临、交谈、产生幻象，就像五旬节派那样说方言。

sentences.en: I think what is obvious, and what lots of people have said, is this is quite obviously a fusion of Christianity and elements of native...
sentences.zh: 我认为显而易见的是，正如许多人所说，这显然是基督教与原住民元素的融合……

sentences.en: I know you say religion is the wrong word.
sentences.zh: 我知道你说“宗教”这个词用得不对。

sentences.en: Native spirituality.
sentences.zh: 是原住民灵性。

sentences.en: I mean, let's say, because it is becoming a religion.
sentences.zh: 我是说，姑且这么说吧，因为它正在变成一种宗教。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Being codified.
sentences.zh: 正在被编纂成体系。

sentences.en: Because the native peoples of America are being Americanized.
sentences.zh: 因为美国原住民正在被美国化。

sentences.en: So it's a fusion of those things, but also it's happening out WeSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这是这些事物的融合，而且它发生在西部。

sentences.en: And there was a lot of Mormonism in there, almost certainly as well.
sentences.zh: 而且几乎可以肯定，其中还包含了很多摩门教的成分。

sentences.en: So all of these things are mixed up.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些东西都混在了一起。

sentences.en: No one doubts that this guy, by the way, will vote.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，没人怀疑沃沃卡这个人。

sentences.en: He's not a con man.
sentences.zh: 他不是骗子。

sentences.en: He's not a demagogue or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 他也不是煽动者之类的。

sentences.en: There's no reason to doubt his sincerity.
sentences.zh: 没有理由怀疑他的诚意。

sentences.en: Well, it's often said that what happens in the kind of colonial peripheries in the long run will blow back and hit the metropoles of the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，人们常说，殖民地边缘发生的事情，从长远来看会反噬西方的中心地带。

sentences.en: And it kind of reminds me of spiritualism in the wake of the First World War.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一战后的招魂术。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: The desperate yearning of people to be in touch with those that they've loved.
sentences.zh: 人们渴望与挚爱之人取得联系的那种绝望。

sentences.en: And these visions in eclipses.
sentences.zh: 还有这些日食中的幻象。

sentences.en: I mean, this is what happens, the visions of Fatima, these extraordinary visions, supposedly, of the Virgin Mary.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就是法蒂玛圣母显灵事件，那些据称是圣母玛利亚的非凡幻象。

sentences.en: Something very similar, this sense of, in the wake of an unbelievable catastrophe, the yearning for communion with what you have loSt.
sentences.zh: 非常相似，这种在难以置信的灾难之后，渴望与失去之物交流的感觉。

sentences.en: And ultimately, this is what it's like.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，就是这种感觉。

sentences.en: And it seems like a kind of foreshadowing of what will happen in Europe a few decades later.
sentences.zh: 这似乎预示了几十年后欧洲将要发生的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think that belief in, I want to commune with the dead.
sentences.zh: 我想那种信仰，即“我想与死者交流”。

sentences.en: I guess because the dead, it's not just because the dead in themselves, it's because of what they represent, which is that old world.
sentences.zh: 我想是因为死者本身，不仅仅是因为死者，而是因为他们所代表的东西，也就是那个旧世界。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because also, I mean, in a way, the most moving thing of all is that they say the buffalo will come back.
sentences.zh: 因为在某种程度上，最感人的地方在于他们说野牛会回来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's so painful.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这太令人心碎了。

sentences.en: Anyway, this starts to spread and, you know, people are excited about it.
sentences.zh: 总之，这开始传播开来，人们对此感到兴奋。

sentences.en: But actually, it probably wouldn't really have caught on if it hadn't been for the fact that in the summer of 1890, as if they haven't suffered enough, there is a terrible drought.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，如果不是因为1890年夏天发生了一场可怕的干旱，这可能根本不会流行起来，仿佛他们受的苦还不够多似的。

sentences.en: There are days and days of, like, baking hot skies and burning winds.
sentences.zh: 接连好几天，天空烈日烘烤，热风灼人。

sentences.en: And all the crops on the reservations of South Dakota wither and die.
sentences.zh: 南达科他州保留地上的所有庄稼都枯萎死亡了。

sentences.en: The hay turns brown.
sentences.zh: 干草变成了褐色。

sentences.en: So, what happened is that by that summer, a version of the ghost dance craze has come to the reservations, but it's been twisted.
sentences.zh: 所以，到了那个夏天，鬼舞热潮的一个版本传到了保留地，但它被扭曲了。

sentences.en: It's much more militant.
sentences.zh: 它变得更加激进。

sentences.en: So, definitely now we have the stuff about the white shirts will protect you from bullets.
sentences.zh: 所以现在肯定有了关于白衬衫能防弹的说法。

sentences.en: So, conflict is kind of expected and it's much more aggressively anti-white settler, as in they will be eliminated, that they will go.
sentences.zh: 因此，冲突在所难免，而且它变得更加强烈地反抗白人定居者，意思是他们会被消灭，他们会离开。

sentences.en: They will go.
sentences.zh: 他们会离开。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as the weeks pass, I mean, people are very hungry, of course.
sentences.zh: 随着几周过去，人们当然非常饥饿。

sentences.en: The baking summer turns very quickly to freezing autumn and winter.
sentences.zh: 炎热的夏天很快转为寒冷的秋天和冬天。

sentences.en: And the dances continue and they become ever more fervent.
sentences.zh: 舞蹈继续进行，而且变得越来越狂热。

sentences.en: People are collapsing and sort of, as you said, sort of speaking in tongues, screaming, foaming at their mouth.
sentences.zh: 人们开始晕倒，正如你所说，开始说方言、尖叫、口吐白沫。

sentences.en: There is this sort of incredible, incredible excitement.
sentences.zh: 有一种难以置信的、难以置信的兴奋感。

sentences.en: Now, all of this might have been very unsettling and incendiary to kind of their new white neighbours.
sentences.zh: 现在，所有这些对他们的新白人邻居来说，可能非常令人不安且具有煽动性。

sentences.en: Of course, they do have white neighbours now.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们现在确实有白人邻居了。

sentences.en: Farmers in the Dakotas who are bound to be a little bit perturbed by this.
sentences.zh: 达科他地区的农民们对此难免会感到有些不安。

sentences.en: Although, to be honest, settlers in the West, I mean, they're used to weird expressions of religious faith.
sentences.zh: 不过说实话，西部地区的定居者们，我是说，他们对各种奇怪的宗教信仰表达方式早就习以为常了。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: People speaking in tongues and babbling, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 人们说着方言，胡言乱语，不是吗？

sentences.en: So, it's not totally weird to them, I guess.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，这对他们来说并不算太奇怪。

sentences.en: But what actually really turbocharges it is how the agent at one particular place, Pine Ridge, handles it.
sentences.zh: 但真正让事态升级的，是派恩里奇（Pine Ridge）那个特定地方的代理人处理这件事的方式。

sentences.en: And here again, we go back to the politics.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们又要回到政治层面了。

sentences.en: Because we said before, the Republican Party is desperate to attract Western voters.
sentences.zh: 因为我们之前说过，共和党急于争取西部的选民。

sentences.en: Elections at this period are really tightly contested.
sentences.zh: 那个时期的选举竞争非常激烈。

sentences.en: And Benjamin Harrison only beat in Grover Cleveland, in the Electoral College, not in the popular vote.
sentences.zh: 本杰明·哈里森（Benjamin Harrison）在选举人团投票中击败了格罗弗·克利夫兰（Grover Cleveland），而不是在普选中获胜。

sentences.en: Everything matters.
sentences.zh: 每一票都至关重要。

sentences.en: And politics in this era is all about patronage.
sentences.zh: 那个时代的政治核心就是政治分肥。

sentences.en: And so, they want to put Republicans into political appointments.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们想把共和党人安插到政治任命的职位上。

sentences.en: And the job of being an Indian agent was a really valuable one.
sentences.zh: 而印第安代理人这个职位非常吃香。

sentences.en: It's kind of plum.
sentences.zh: 算是个肥差。

sentences.en: You control thousands of dollars of contracts to feed the people on the reservation and to build mills and schools and things.
sentences.zh: 你可以掌控数千美元的合同，用于为保留地的人民提供食物，以及建造磨坊、学校等等。

sentences.en: And the South Dakota Republican Party gave the job at Pine Ridge that year, 1890, to somebody who could not be more useless.
sentences.zh: 而南达科他州的共和党在那一年，即1890年，把派恩里奇的这个职位给了一个再无能不过的人。

sentences.en: He's called Daniel F.
sentences.zh: 他叫丹尼尔·F·罗耶（Daniel F. Royer）。

sentences.en: Royer.
sentences.zh: 罗耶。

sentences.en: I mean, he's 36, but in that time, he had been a doctor, a newspaperman, a banker, a territorial delegate, a drugstore guy, and, says one person who writes about him,
sentences.zh: 我是说，他当时36岁，但在那之前，他当过医生、报社记者、银行家、领地代表、药店职员，据一位写过他的人说，

sentences.en: and quite possibly a narcotics addict.
sentences.zh: 而且很可能还是个瘾君子。

sentences.en: So, he's just a serial failure.
sentences.zh: 所以，他就是一个彻头彻尾的失败者。

sentences.en: But he's got connections.
sentences.zh: 但他有门路。

sentences.en: They give him the job.
sentences.zh: 他们给了他这份工作。

sentences.en: He pitches up on the reservation, and he totally loses it.
